description: This file defines a class ErrorCode within the PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Reader\Xls namespace. The class contains a mapping of error codes used in Excel files to their corresponding error strings, and includes a static method to look up error strings based on error codes.

classes.name: ErrorCode
classes.description: A class that provides a mapping from Excel error codes to their string representations and a method to retrieve error strings based on error codes.

methods.name: lookup
methods.description: Returns the error string corresponding to a given error code, or false if the code is not recognized.
